comments.author: @leechumbley5440
comments.text: I noted that the concentration of population was near the US border, which I always thought was due to severe cold further north. I thought the Canadian Shield, source of so many finds about the pre-Cambrian world, would be maybe the size of a county. Your excellent exposition disavowed me of both these notions. That the ice pack was so massive, and scoured the topsoil away, leaving bare pre-Cambrian rock, explains everything.  Thank you for this enlightenment.
